trigger.description: The user-global store contains memories, but its Frankensearch index cannot be safely used and complete current-source lexical fallback is unavailable. Examples include corrupt or incompatible assets, redirected paths, a bounded-source retrieval failure, and an explicit historical request against a missing or stale global index. Clean current missing/stale indexes within the source bounds emit global_live_snapshot_lexical instead. Workspace retrieval remains available while global recall is explicitly marked incomplete.
setup_commands: ee remember --global --level procedural --kind rule 'Global index fixture.' --json
# In an isolated fixture, make the global index metadata incompatible or corrupt.
